FIRE ALERT

Ilang bahay ang nadamay sa sunog sa may kahabaan ng  Roxas St. sa Brgy. 103 sa Tondo, Maynila. Magha-hatinggabi nitong Huwebes nang sumiklab ang apoy.

Agad itinaas sa unang alarma ang sunog bago idineklarang fire under control pasado alas-dose nang hatinggabi. Walang naiulat na nasaktan o nasugatan sa insidente.

📸: Manila DRRM Office

data.english_translation: FIRE ALERT Several homes were burned along Roxas St. in Brgy. 103 in Tondo, Manila. It was midnight on Thursday when the fire broke out. The fire was quickly raised to the first alarm before being declared fire under control at midnight. No one was reported or injured in the incident.uku: Manila DRRM Office
